description: Search Harris Teeter groceries by keyword at your pickup store — returns UPC, name, brand, size, price, sale price, unit price and pickup stock. Use the UPC with ht_add_to_cart. With Kroger API credentials set it runs without the browser (source: api.kroger.com); that API prices produce per pound where the website prices it per item.

locationId.description: Price at this 8-digit store location id, for this call only (needs Kroger API credentials).

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging.

pickupOnly.description: Only items available for pickup at your store (default true).

query.description: What to search for, e.g. "2% milk" or "bananas".

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands; "raw" returns the upstream payload unprojected. compact returns a projection of the documented fields; "full" returns the API payload minified; "raw" pretty-prints it.

zip.description: Price at the Harris Teeter nearest this ZIP, for this call only (needs Kroger API credentials).

name: ht_search_products
